subject: literacy
concept: Forming a clear research question before starting to look for information
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student turns a broad topic card into a specific question card with the mentor's guidance
exercise.pictorial: Student sorts questions into 'too broad,' 'too narrow,' and 'just right' categories
exercise.abstract: Student writes a clear, specific, answerable research question on a topic of interest

misconception_flags: writes a question so broad it can't be meaningfully researched (e.g. 'tell me about space')

interest_binding: topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
